- Dried, crumpled tissue at the junction
- No white mycelium visible

**Comparison to references:**
- **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers (Bugwood_4):** Very dark/black canker at soil line, darker than test image

- **Bacterial_Canker (stem):** Dissected stem showing internal browning, different presentation
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot:** Bleached/white stem near soil line, doesn't match
- **Gray_Mold (stem):** Tan/brown elongated lesion on stem with slightly banded texture — **closest visual match** to the test image's color and texture
- **Phytophthora_Blight:** Dark/black collapsing stem, doesn't match
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt:** Internal vascular dissection, different presentation
- **Southern_Blight:** Bleached white stem, doesn't match

The Gray_Mold stem reference (tan-brown lesion on stem segment) is the closest visual match. The color, texture, and presentation of the brown necrotic tissue at the stem junction is consistent with Botrytis stem lesions.
